Subject: On-call rotation changes starting June 2

Hi team,

Starting June 2, the on-call rotation moves from weekly shifts to shifts every 3 days. The goal is fresher coverage, less burnout, and more balanced weeks for everyone.

The on-call pool now has 9 engineers. To recognize the extra effort, each shift will pay a $150 bonus. Thank you for the work you do keeping our systems running.

What to expect:
- Shifts run every 3 days.
- Every changeover includes clear handoff notes.
- You get a $150 bonus for each shift you cover.

If you have questions, talk to your team lead or post in the #on-call channel.

Thanks,
The Engineering Leadership Team
